card.name: Two things joined into one
card.fires_on: Words right after two items have been named together, where the text goes on to say they happen at once, are combined, or form one whole (e.g. "at the same time", "combined into a single").

modes.label: Same time or same thing
modes.description: The word "same" or similar words that mark two things as one or simultaneous.
modes.example: often at the<< same>> time. For more than fifty years she

modes.label: Combined into one
modes.description: Linking words after two named items that are merged into a single unit or process.
modes.example: It essentially combines main memory and cache memory<< in>> a single chip.

modes.label: Paired drug or item names
modes.description: The end of a pair of items joined by "and", such as two drugs or two steps.
modes.example: Zidovudine and Sulfamethoxazole and Trimethoprim<< Injection>> are known to induce hematological abnormalities.

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning 'same', 'unified' and 'complementary', and away from words like 'both' and 'the two'.
card.plain: It lights up when two things have just been named and the text is about to say they are combined or done together.
